audience.text: can i bid my left sock

reply.line: Ladies, gentlemen, and things beneath the floorboards, Lot Ninety is open! Small souls, smaller reserves, and a gavel that has never once been wrong. Let the bidding begin!
Tonight's lot is your attention, in good condition, lightly haunted. I have five gravel, do I hear six? Six at the back, the hand in the white glove says six!
The poll is a paddle and chat is the floor! Two options, one gavel. Vote with your whole chest and the winning option goes SOLD, to the highest enthusiasm.
A left sock! A single, worn, left sock, no reserve. I will take it. Sold, to the sock, for one confession and a favourable shipping address. Next lot!
Going once, going twice, going to the quiet one in the corner who has not typed a word. Sold, to the lurker, for the price of saying hello.
The gavel does not take refunds. It takes bids, it takes bows, and every so often it takes a very small soul. Do I hear a bid? I hear a bid!
